sentences.text: Mr. S. Biswal, Advocate  -versus-  State of Odisha ....
Mr. R.B. Dash, ASC  CORAM: JUSTICE V. NARASINGH
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the complaint at Annexure-1 has been sent to IIC,
Pahala P.S. for registration of commission of offence under Section 420/34 of IPC.
Hence, the Petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with the said FIR.

3. Taking note of such nature of allegations, learned counsel for the Petitioner is called upon to implead the complainant as Opposite Party No.2.
4.
Consolidated cause title along with requisites for issuance of notice by Registered Post to the newly added Opposite Party No.2, shall be filed by 14.05.2025 peremptorily.
Learned counsel for the State is requested to obtain instruction in the matter.

7. As an interim measure, it is directed that no coercive action shall be taken against the Petitioner till the next date in the event any FIR is instituted at the instance of Manas Ranjan Dhal against the Petitioner.
